claim_check.reason: The claim states that the acceleration is linear. Acceleration is the slope of the velocity-time graph (the middle chart). If acceleration were linear, the velocity graph would be a quadratic function (a parabola). However, the velocity curve shown is more complex than a simple parabola; its slope (acceleration) becomes zero around t=22s and again around t=34s. A linear function can only be zero at one point (unless it's the zero function), so the acceleration cannot be linear over the entire duration shown.

claim: The second equation of motion has a linear acceleration.
